sql: SELECT u.customer_name, c.case_id, c.decided_at FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.customers u ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'declined' AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' ORDER BY c.decided_at LIMIT 5
explanation: Five declined applications from October 2026, with the customer's name.
